name: acc-0014
description: Acceptance 0014: a refused accept (409 CapacityExceeded) falls back to the next bid; concurrent rentals never overcommit a bidder.

actions.label: Run 0014
actions.description: Three rentals on three one-VM bidders: refusals, the fallback, all Held, all released.

actions.label: Run 0014 concurrent
actions.description: Four rentals on two two-VM bidders: all Held, no overcommit, all released.

actions.label: Run 0014 exhausted
actions.description: Three rentals on two one-VM bidders: two Held, the third refused by both, its new RFP fails at once.

actions.label: Run 0014 giveup
actions.description: Bidders full, a rental with a short --expires-in waits in rounds and fails at its deadline: gave up waiting for capacity.

actions.label: Run 0014 wait
actions.description: Bidders full, a rental waits for capacity; a filler is released and the rental is Held within about a backoff.

actions.label: Run 0014 back to back
actions.description: Six small VMs one after another on one bidder: every one Held, none ended before it came on network.

hooks.reason: the refused accepts, then every contract record, RecordNotFound
